title: Canonical ordinary module base-change map
statement: Let $X,S,T,X_1$ be schemes and let $f:X\to S$, $f_1:X_1\to T$, $u:T\to S$, $v:X_1\to X$ satisfy $f\circ v=u\circ f_1$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use the tensor-formula module pullbacks and direct images with their canonical adjunctions $a^*\dashv a_*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, define the ordinary module base-change map $\beta_F:u^*f_*F\to f_{1*}v^*F$ to be the inverse of the adjunction bijection for $u$, applied to the composite $f_*F\xrightarrow{f_*\eta_{v,F}}f_*v_*v^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}(f\circ v)_*v^*F=(u\circ f_1)_*v^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}u_*f_{1*}v^*F$. The comparison maps here are the canonical sectionwise composition identifications of direct images, and $\eta_v$ is the unit of the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction. Only this morphism is defined; no invertibility property is asserted.

lean.statement:
def moduleBaseChangeMap {X S T X₁ : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ T) (u₁ : T ⟶ S) (v : X₁ ⟶ X)
    (h : v ≫ f = f₁ ≫ u₁) (F : X.Modules) :
    (tensorPullback u₁).obj ((pushforward f).obj F) ⟶
      (pushforward f₁).obj ((tensorPullback v).obj F)
